title: Short-form video editor
description:
Short-Form Video Editor — Ongoing Series (Part-Time)



Job Description:

We're producing a short-form video series for my videos.



I need a video editor who can turn raw footage and a detailed editing brief into punchy, engaging 30–60 second videos for LinkedIn, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



What you'll be working with:



I'll send you raw video (shot on iPhone, to-camera) plus a written brief for every episode. The brief tells you ideas of what happens at each timestamp — where to cut, where to punch-in zoom, where B-roll goes, what on-screen captions to add, and when. Your job is to execute that brief with skill, add your own creative touches where it makes sense, and make it feel polished without overproducing it.



What the videos look like:



Clean, minimal, engaging. Think dry humour, sharp cuts, and well-timed captions — not flashy transitions or heavy effects. The energy comes from pacing and edit timing, not motion graphics. Captions on screen throughout. Subtle sound design welcome. Background music track (I'll provide or you source from royalty-free libraries).



The edit style in detail:



Punch-in zooms for emphasis (simple crop reframes, not animated). Quick B-roll cutaways over voiceover. Rapid-fire insert shots (phone screens, Slack messages, business cards). On-screen text — clean sans-serif, white, hard cut on/off, no bouncing or sliding animations. Music that builds subtly and drops out at key 
nts. Comfortable pacing — not frantic, not slow.



What I'm looking for:



Experience editing short-form vertical video (Reels, Shorts, TikTok). Strong sense of timing and pacing — you know when to cut and when to let a 
nt breathe. Clean caption/text work. Able to take a detailed brief and execute it precisely, while also knowing when to add something I didn't think of. Reliable turnaround — I'll need episodes back within 24 hours of sending footage.



Software: CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut — whatever you use is fine as long as the output is right.

This is a paid test first. I'll send you raw footage and the editing brief for Episode 1. You edit it. If the quality is right, this becomes ongoing work — 2 to 4 videos per week across the series.



Hours: Part-time, project-based. Expect 5–10 hours per week to start, growing as the series scales.



How to apply:

Send me a link to 2–3 short-form videos you've edited (Reels, Shorts, or TikTok — not long-form). If you don't have short-form samples, don't apply.



In your message, tell me what you'd do differently if a video's hook isn't landing in the first two seconds. I want to hear how you think, not just what tools you use.



Please don't send a template application.

title: Appointment Setter (Recruitment | Remote)
description:
Appointment Setter (Recruitment | Remote)





Full-Time | Independent Contractor | US Hours





We’re looking for a full-time Appointment Setter to support a high-volume recruitment operation working across multiple US markets.



This position is offered on an independent contractor basis and is structured as an ongoing, long-term role for the right person. The focus is on consistency, performance, reliability, and the ability to take ownership of your work.



While the role initially focuses heavily on outbound calling and candidate scheduling, successful tea
mbers typically take on additional operational and administrative responsibilities as they become familiar with our systems and processes. We are looking for someone who is comfortable learning new skills and growing with the role over time.





What You’ll Be Doing:



• Calling candidates who have applied for roles and confirming key details



• Reaching out to matched candidates who fit active positions



• Booking candidates into interviews



• Updating CRM records and maintaining accurate candidate information



• Handling a high volume of outbound calls each day



• Tracking activity and maintaining accurate records



• Working toward daily and weekly booking targets



• Supporting recruitment operations through data entry, scheduling, and administrative tasks



• Learning internal systems and processes to take on additional responsibilities over time





What This Role Requires:



• Strong spoken English with a clear, natural tone



• Confidence on the phone and ability to guide conversations



• High energy and a positive, professional attitude



• Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment



• Strong organisation and attention to detail



• Strong computer literacy and confidence learning new systems and software



• Ability to balance phone-based work with administrative responsibilities



• Reliable internet and ability to work US hours consistently



• A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of your work rather than simply complete assigned tasks





Nice to Have (Not Essential):



• Previous experience in sales, appointment setting, recruitment, or outbound calling



• Experience working in a high-volume or target-driven environment



• Experience using CRMs, scheduling tools, or other business software





Compensation:



• Fixed weekly base pay: $200 (40 hours)



• Weekly performance bonuses available after the probation period



• Full-time hours (40 hours per week, including a Saturday shift)





To Be Considered, You Must Submit:



• Your CV



• A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you’re a good fit for this role





Applications missing either requirement will not be considered.





Next Steps:



We are looking to fill this position quickly and will be contacting shortlisted candidates as applications come in.

We are looking for a reliable B2B cold caller to help with outbound lead generation and appointment setting for a small business outreach campaign.

title: Social Media Content Creator & Media Admin Assistant
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

 

We are a church seeking a full-time, detail-oriented video editor and media assistant to create short-form social media videos from our weekly sermons and to provide administrative support to our media team. This is a long-term, ongoing role for the right person. We start with a paid trial task to make sure it's a great fit on both sides.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

Content Creation (primary focus):

- Edit 9 short-form videos per week from our sermon recordings:

  - 3 videos from Wednesday's teaching

  - 3 videos from Friday's teaching

  - 3 videos from Sunday's teaching

  - Each set includes 2 short clips and 1 quote-style video

- Add voiceover and maintain our specific branding (colors, fonts, lower thirds, intro/outro) on every video

- Add captions and subtitles

- Select clips that reflect sound biblical and theological understanding of the message, not just what sounds catchy

- Identify trending topics, formats, or titles relevant to the sermon's themes, and use them to shape video titles and hooks where appropriate

- Deliver all videos for a given service within 72 hours of that service (for example, Sunday's videos due by Wednesday, Wednesday's videos due by Saturday, Friday's videos due by Monday)

- All videos require explicit approval before publishing. Once approved, you will schedule and post them using our social media content calendar tool

 

Media Admin Support:

- Organize and manage uploaded sermon files

- Maintain and update our content calendar, and schedule and publish approved videos across our social media channels

- Handle data entry related to sermon and content tracking

- Assist with
 and calendar management related to media tasks

- Support other day-to-day media administrative needs as they come up

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

- Must be a practicing Christian with working knowledge of scripture and biblical themes. This role requires understanding the message well enough to select clips that represent it accurately, not just what sounds catchy

- Proven experience editing short-form vertical video (Reels, TikTok, Shorts style). Portfolio or demo reel required

- Comfortable working with voiceover audio and matching existing brand guidelines

- Awareness of social media trends and ability to connect sermon themes to trending topics, formats, or titles

- Proficiency in one or more of: Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Canva Pro, After Effects (tell us which you use)

- Familiarity with ClickUp (our project management system) and Google Workspace

- Strong organizational skills. Comfortable managing files, calendars, and recurring deadlines across multiple services per week

- Good written English communication

- Prior experience with church or ministry content is a strong plus

 

SCHEDULE

 

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Three services per week (Wednesday, Friday, Sunday), each requiring 3 videos delivered within 72 hours of that service

- Must be available for a 1-hour check-in during US Central business hours on Mondays between 10 am and 2 pm.

 

COMPENSATION

 

- $750 per month, full-time

- Paid trial task required before hire (see below)

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

1. Submit your resume and a link to your portfolio or demo reel (short-form video editing required)

2. Note which editing software you use

3. If shortlisted, you will be invited to complete a paid trial task (details provided separately)

title: Long form and short for video editor
description:
# Part-Time YouTube Video Editor (Long-Term Opportunity)



I'm looking for a skilled and reliable video editor from the Philippines to work with me on a growing Christian YouTube channel focused on **dominion, business, leadership, and personal development according to biblical principles**.



My goal is to build this channel consistently over the long term, so I'm looking for someone who wants an ongoing working relationship rather than a one-off project.



## What You'll Be Editing



Each month, you'll typically edit:



* 6–8 long-form YouTube videos.

* A minimum of **5 engaging short-form clips** from each long-form video.

* Videos for YouTube Shorts and other vertical platforms.



## Editing Style



I'm **not** looking for flashy edits.



I'm looking for someone who can produce content that is:



* Clean

* Elegant

* Professional

* Minimalist

* Easy to watch



Your job is to improve the viewing experience without distracting from the message.



Long-form edits should include:



* Removing mistakes and unnecessary pauses.

* Cleaning up awkward 
nts.

* Improving pacing.

* Subtle Scripture references and Bible verses displayed on screen where appropriate.

* Simple titles or lower thirds if needed.



Short-form edits should:



* Have a strong hook.

* Maintain fast pacing.

* Include clean captions if appropriate.

* Use soft, atmospheric background music where it enhances the content (never overpowering the speaker).



## What I'm Looking For



You should:



* Have previous experience editing YouTube content.

* Have a good understanding of English.

* Be able to identify the strongest 
nts to turn into short-form videos.

* Deliver consistent, professional work.

* Be open to feedback and continual improvement.

* Be dependable and communicate clearly.



## Your Equipment & Workflow



You must provide your own:



* Editing software.

* Computer capable of editing high-quality video.

* Stable internet connection.

* A reliable file transfer solution for large video files (such as Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer, or another secure platform).



Videos must be returned in their original resolution and high quality without unnecessary compression or any noticeable loss in image or audio quality.



## Trial Edit



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a **short unpaid trial edit** using a sample of my footage. This allows me to assess your editing style, attention to detail, and ability to follow instructions before offering ongoing work.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. If you have a portfolio of edits, show me what you have done.

3. The editing software you use.

5. Your typical turnaround time.

6. The word **"Dominion"** as the first word of your application so I know you've read this post carefully.

7. Tell me which YouTube creator's editing style you admire most and why.



Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be considered.



I'm looking for someone who takes pride in producing excellent work, values consistency, communicates well, and wants to grow with the channel over the long term.





SALARY WILL INCREASE ACCORDINGLY

Competitor Research: Finding dropshipping stores and competitor brands across various niches that are successful on Pinterest.



Ad Transparency: Monitoring competitor ad campaigns using the Pinterest Ads Repository / Ad Library.



Trend Spotting: Leveraging Pinterest Trends and the visual search engine to identify upcoming viral products and niches.



Geo-Research: Using a VPN to research competitor activity, top pins, and localized trends across different regions.



Documentation: Structuring and documenting your findings clearly so our creative and marketing teams can take action.



Growth Potential: As you grow into the role, you will have the opportunity to expand into full product research—identifying winning products, planning creative boards, and spotting new scaling opportunities for our store.



What we're looking for:

Required:



Proven experience in e-commerce competitor research, Pinterest management, or a similar analytical role.



Deep familiarity with Pinterest Trends and understanding how the Pinterest algorithm works.



Experience with the Pinterest Ad Library (or similar social ad research tools).



Comfortable using a VPN for geo-based market research.



Strong analytical skills with a keen eye for visual trends and detail.



Strong written and spoken English communication skills.



General knowledge of how dropshipping stores and e-commerce businesses operate.



A plus (not required):



Basic understanding of Pinterest Tag, Pinterest Business Manager, or Catalog feeds.



Experience running or analyzing Pinterest Ads.



Background in fashion, home decor, or other highly visual e-commerce niches.



What we offer:

???? $5/hour



???? Flexible hours: Starting at 2–4 hours/day, 5 days a week.



???? Room to grow: More hours become available as you prove your value.



???? Real career potential: Top performers will have the opportunity to take on product research, creative strategy, and broader responsibilities within the company.



???? A supportive team environment in a fast-growing e-commerce business.



This is a great opportunity for someone who loves visual research, spotting trends before they go viral, and understanding what makes an e-commerce store successful on Pinterest. If you're analytical, self-driven, and eager to grow with a scaling brand, we want to hear from you.

title: Channel Testing VA
description:
VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — YOUTUBE ACCOUNT TESTING (ANTIDETECT BROWSER EXPERIENCE REQUIRED)



Type: Part-time, project-based to start (long-term role for the right person)

Rate: 100$/month

Hours: Roughly 2–4 hours of active work per day during a testing cycle, plus periodic check-ins





ABOUT THE JOB



I run a network of faceless YouTube channels. Before we publish real content on a new account, we test it — some accounts never get impressions at all, while others pick up impressions fast. Your job is to run that testing process end to end.



The full workflow is documented in step-by-step video SOPs, so you won't need to figure anything out on your own. What I need from you is the ability to follow instructions exactly, in the exact order given, and to ask questions the 
nt anything is unclear.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Set up browser profiles in an antidetect browser using proxies I provide

- Run IP quality checks on each profile and log the results in a tracking sheet

- Log into the accounts I provide and warm them up with natural YouTube activity over several hours (this mostly runs in the background across multiple profiles — you just check in periodically)

- Record simple real-world footage on your phone and upload short test videos to each channel

- Track each channel's impressions over the following days and record everything in the sheet



The exact settings, tools, and steps are all covered in the SOPs once you're hired.





REQUIREMENTS



- Hands-on experience with antidetect browsers (AdsPower, Multilogin, GoLogin, Dolphin, Incogniton, etc.) — mandatory, do not apply without it

- Basic understanding of proxies

- A computer that can run at least 5–6 browser profiles at the same time (16GB RAM ideal)

- A smartphone that can record widescreen/landscape video

- Stable internet and availability to check on profiles at intervals throughout the day

- Extreme attention to detail: one wrong setting invalidates an entire testing cycle

- You ask questions instead of assuming. If something is unclear, I want a message, not a guess

- Basic written English: You'll write short, simple video titles and descriptions yourself (no AI tools for this)





NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with YouTube channel warming or account farming

- Familiarity with YouTube Studio analytics

- Experience managing multiple Gmail accounts





WHAT YOU GET



- Video SOPs for every single task

- All tools, proxies, and accounts provided

- Direct communication with me (the owner) and fast answers to any questions

- If the first testing cycle goes well, this grows into a long-term role handling daily video publishing across my main channels





HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word GREENLIGHT so I know you actually read this post. Then answer these four questions:



1. Which antidetect browsers have you used, and what did you use them for?

2. How much RAM does your computer have, and how many browser profiles can you run at once?

3. Have you done YouTube account warming or channel testing before? Briefly describe what you did.

4. What hours are you available each day, and what is your timezone?



Write your application yourself. This job requires you to write in your own words, and AI-written applications are easy to spot.



Applications that don't start with the code word or skip the questions will not be read.

title: Part-Time Social Media Manager & Operations Assistant
description:
Building Bosses is a UK-based property network that teaches entrepreneurs and aspiring business owners how to invest in property. We are looking for a long-term, trusted, and diligent remote social media & operations manager to join our growing team. This is a starting role with explicit scope to grow. This role has a clear pathway to scale into a full-time operations and community manager with increased compensation and responsibilities.



At Building Bosses, people are at the heart of what we do. We aim to build strong professional relationships and help each other to show up as our best selves every day while maintaining our top-performance ethos.

In this role, you will be at the core of our operations by managing our multi-platform social media presence and executing administrative tasks. Please note this position focuses on professional copywriting, admin, social media optimisation, and backend operations (video editing is not required however 2+ years experience in Social Media Management is mandatory).





Requirements



Fluent Written and Spoken English: Excellent grammar, spelling, and vocabulary, with the ability to write in a professional voice.

Independent Troubleshooting: Because we work in different time zones, real-time help is limited. You must be able to learn new software updates, and troubleshoot technical solutions independently before escalating to management for assistance.

Background: You must have 2+ years of remote assistant or social media management experience with UK-based clients. References will be required. Please ensure your university degree is listed on your resume. Advanced experience in google suite, notion, skool, instagram, tiktok and youtube is required.

Communication Standards: Communication is critical in this role. Because we operate across different time zones, you must maintain the following mandatory standards:

WhatsApp will be utilized as our primary tool for daily operational communication.

Acknowledge and respond to all messages and
s within 0-to-12-hours.

Be available to receive and join phone calls to handle urgent tasks.

A comprehensive report detailing tasks completed, tasks in progress, and any blockers must be submitted every week on a set day.





Core Weekly Tasks



1. Social Media Management - Planning, Publishing & Optimisation



Platforms: Posting to TikTok, Instagram Reels, Threads, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.

Copywriting: Draft clear, relevant, and value-driven captions that align with the brand's established voice and tone. The text should be easy to understand and organised using line breaks. 

All written copy must be human-authored; we utilize AI detection tools as part of our regular quality control. The submission of AI-generated work constitutes a breach of contract and may result in immediate termination.

Hashtags: Include 2-4 relevant hashtags at the end of the caption after 2 line breaks so they stay hidden behind the "See More" button. Avoid hashtags that could lead to account restriction. Also put hashtags and SEO keywords hidden off-screen for the algorithm.

Platform Tweaks: Manually pair TikTok/IG uploads with specific trending UK audio. Write catchy titles under 60 characters. Turn the video concept into a text post for LinkedIn.

Past Analysis & Calendar planning: Review our history of top-performing content to see which hooks, structures, and topics got the best results.

Hook Writing: For every video topic provided, write a few high-converting hook options to grab attention in the first 2 seconds, based on successful UK top performing accounts.

Trend Tracking: Spend 1 hour a week researching rising audio trends and competitor styles within the UK property and influencer space.

Ad-Hoc Operational Support: Assist with administrative logistics, basic script writing support, and event planning coordination as needed.



2. Skool Operations & Admin - Platform Building & Upkeep



Text Formatting: Move and re-format raw text from documents, google sheets and PDFs into Skool. Follow our formatting and spacing rules, use bold paragraph titles and always paste our mandatory copyright header at the top of every page.

Resource Embedding: Embed tools and documents into Skool using html  codes. The tools must be made non-downloadable so experience in creating non-downloadable files is mandatory.

Community Vetting: Check incoming member requests for our group daily. Only approve people who fully answer the entry questions. Flag spam accounts or incomplete profiles to management immediately.





How to Apply



Address your message directly to Lewis. Applications that utilize generic or automated titles (such as "Dear Sir/Ma'am," "Respected Hiring Manager") may not be considered.

Include your portfolio link, please make sure it shows real samples of your work (e.g. captions you wrote, posts you published, documents you’ve created,
s you’ve sent or layouts you designed). Please do not share pages of client testimonials.

Please include a short cover letter explaining why you want to apply for this role and your experience with UK audiences.





The Trial Project Phase (Paid Project)



Dates & Deadlines: The trial project phase starts toward the end of July 2026. This will be a timed, paid evaluation project.

title: VIDEO EDITOR
description:
Hi Dear,



I reviewed your portfolio and your editing style fits exactly what I'm looking for.



I run a YouTube channel focused on candy entertainment content: candy, chocolate, gummies, and all types of sweets — ASMR/satisfying style. Daily short videos (30–60s), colorful and vibrant.



I'm hiring ONE editor for a long-term monthly arrangement through Fiverr — target: 5 VIDEOS PER DAY (~150/month), guaranteed work for months. If you can't handle this volume alone, tell me honestly your real daily capacity, or whether you work with a small team.



Quality benchmark: MrBeast-level. The editing never looks cheap. My terms are fixed:



RETENTION & PACING (non-negotiable):

• Custom AE hook in the first 1–3 seconds — most striking moment as the first frame: the candy cut, the gummy stretch, the chocolate pour

• Visual change every 1.5–3s: candy macro zooms, speed ramps — zero dead moments

• Pattern interrupts every 5–7s (color pop, SFX spike, text slam)

• Loop-friendly ending connecting to the first frame — critical for Shorts algorithm



SOUND DESIGN (non-negotiable — 50% of candy content):

• Crunches, squishes, cuts — clean, enhanced, amplified: noise removal + EQ + compression

• Frame-synced SFX: pops, squishes, snaps

• Never cover ASMR sounds with music

• Final mastering at -14 LUFS

• 100% copyright-free music and SFX — your responsibility



VISUALS:

• Candy colors must POP — vibrant cinematic grading, one approved look, locked

• Playful colorful animated captions fitting the candy theme, keyword emphasis, inside safe zones

• Consistent brand: same fonts/colors every video (built together week 1, then locked)

• Templates ONLY for minor elements — overall look fully custom



TECHNICAL: 9:16, 1080x1920+, high-bitrate export, no watermarks



WORKFLOW (non-negotiable):

• I provide a detailed brief per video — follow it exactly, no changes without my approval

• Daily batch of 5 videos delivered within 24 hours

• Unlimited revisions until spec is met

• Source files (AE/PR) with every video — no exceptions



PRICING: At 150 videos/month with guaranteed income, I pay a volume rate — NOT single-video pricing. Send your best final monthly price. I'm comparing several editors this week.



TO APPLY, send:

1. Your monthly price for 5 videos/day (best and final)

2. Your honest max daily capacity at this quality

3. 3 YouTube links of published videos you edited — food/candy/ASMR preferred

4. Your 3-second retention strategy (one line)

title: Social Media Content VA
description:
The Role



We're a pre-launch clean pet grooming brand building an audience with ingredient-education video. The founder films herself and records voiceovers; you handle everything else, sourcing the visuals, building the graphics, editing, scheduling, posting, and community. The goal is that the founder is NOT tracking down images or assets; you are. You're organized, resourceful, and good at turning a founder's raw clips and a fact sheet into a polished, scroll-stopping video.



What you'll do



-Edit raw footage into finished Reels, TikToks, and Shorts: cuts, captions, text overlays, trending audio, and a strong hook in the first 2 seconds.

-Build videos in two formats: (1) the founder's voiceover played over ingredient labels and info visuals, and (2) the founder talking to camera with info graphics running in the background.

-Source the visuals so the founder doesn't have to: find ingredient-label images and product photos to feature, plus relevant b-roll and stock images (mindful of usage rights).

-Create and add on-screen graphics: green / yellow / red flag indicators, EWG score callouts, simple info cards, and text overlays, from the founder's fact sheets.

-Write captions and hashtags in brand voice (playful, warm, educational) from the founder's talking points.

-Schedule and post across Instagram and TikTok (plus Pinterest / YouTube Shorts repurposing) on an agreed calendar.

-Light community management: reply to comments and DMs in brand voice, and flag anything that needs the founder.

-Maintain a shared asset library, raw footage in, finished assets out, plus saved label images, product shots, and reusable graphic templates, so nothing gets re-hunted.

-Send a simple monthly performance snapshot: reach, follower growth, saves/shares, top posts, and
 signups driven from social.



You should have

-A portfolio of short-form videos you've edited (Reels / TikToks). This is the #1 requirement.

-Strong short-form editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar).

-Graphic and simple motion-graphics ability (Canva, CapCut, or After Effects) for on-screen flags, score callouts, and info cards.

-Resourcefulness at sourcing images, product photos, and stock footage, and awareness of usage rights.

-Good caption writing and a feel for hooks, trends, and hashtags on Instagram and TikTok.

-Experience with a scheduling tool (Later, Metricool, Planoly, or Buffer).

-Reliability and proactive communication. You hit the posting cadence without being chased.

Nice to have

-Pet, lifestyle, or clean-beauty / DTC brand experience.

-Community management experience and light analytics reporting.



Logistics



-Hours: ~10–15 per week to start, growing toward launch. [Adjust]

-Tools: shared Google Drive/Dropbox for footage and assets, a scheduling tool, Canva/CapCut. Brand voice guide and ingredient fact sheets provided.

-Cadence to support: about 4 short videos per week plus daily stories, repurposed across platforms.

-Weekly check-in with the founder.

-Compensation: Please share your rate and availability.



Brand voice guardrails (you'll get a full guide)



-Human and warm. No AI-sounding copy, and no em dashes.

-Cosmetic/grooming claims only. Never medical or drug claims (no 'cures,' 'treats,' 'heals').

-Educate about ingredients and categories. Never name or criticize specific competitor brands unless the founder has cleared it.

-EWG wording: 'formulated with EWG 1–2 rated ingredients.' Never say 'EWG Verified' (we're not certified yet).

-Use only the founder's approved fact sheets for any ingredient claim, and route anything uncertain to the founder before posting.



To apply



Send your portfolio (2–3 short-form videos you edited, ideally some with on-screen graphics), your rate, your weekly availability, and one sentence on why clean pet care appeals to you.

title: Instagram DM Appointment Setter (High-Ticket / No AI Bots)
description:
We are a high-ticket business looking for an elite, hyper-conversational DM Appointment Setter to join our team.

This is not a cold outbound or traditional corporate VA role. You will not be spamming strangers or copy-pasting dead scripts. Our outbound VA handles the cold outreach and hands warm, active conversations over to you. Your sole job is to take over the conversation and move them smoothly into a booked sales call.



We are looking for a long-term, multi-year relationship with an A-player who wants to grow with us.



The Vibe:

Think "cocktail party" or "charismatic barista." We communicate in a highly personal, casual, and non-commercial way. You must understand US culture, nuance, and slang. If your default setting is "Good day, respected sir, how may I assist you today?" this is not the role for you.



What is Expected:

True Fluency: Mastery of casual, conversational English (objection handling, persuasion, and reading between the lines).

Speed to Lead: You must maintain lightning-fast response times (under 15 minutes) during your active shift blocks.

Pipeline Management: Managing conversations from A-Z and being relentless (but polite) with follow-ups.

Consistency: Delivering daily call proposals leading to a target of 10 qualified calls per week.

Coverage: 4 hours of active day-to-day communication spread strategically over an 8-hour window (US EST peak hours).



What We Give:

Base Pay: $400-$500/mo base + 5% commission (depending on experience) for a part-time split shift.

Uncapped Commission: 5% commission on all bookings that close (Our framework has been responsible for $95K/month during peak seasons).

World-Class Training: In-depth sales/setting training and direct access to the founders.

Growth: Weekly team huddles to evaluate your performance and help you close more deals.



HOW TO APPLY (Read Closely):

Do NOT just send a standard resume or a text pitch. If you use a ChatGPT-generated cover letter, you will be ignored instantly.

To apply, you must send a 60-second audio note or Loom video answering these four things:



1) Start message with “SETTING” so we recognise the role you sign up for.

2) Why do you excel at casual, "barista-vibe" sales conversations instead of corporate scripts?

3) Tell us about a time you flipped a skeptical prospect into a booked call.

4) Confirm you are comfortable with a $250-$300 base + 5% commission structure starting part-time.

Applications without a voice note/video will be automatically deleted.



BONUS: Full export and proof of previous DM setting experience (not phone setting) actual KPIs, examples, conversations, the more clarity provide, the more evidence we build to consider you within the role.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive

Customer Conversations | Appointment Setting | Relationship Building



Location: Remote – Philippines



Hours: Approximately 10 hours per week initially



Salary: Competitive hourly rate plus performance bonus. Paid monthly.



Do you genuinely enjoy talking to people?



Can you build rapport quickly?



Can you have an engaging conversation with someone you've never spoken to before?



Can you recognise an opportunity when others can't?



If so, we'd love to hear from you.



I'm Steve, Managing Director of Varissa, a growing UK business specialising in commercial finance, residential mortgages, vehicle finance and prestige vehicle sourcing.



I'm looking for someone to become a long-term member of our team, helping us introduce our services to new business customers throughout the UK.



This is not a scripted call centre role.



We are looking for someone who enjoys conversations, builds trust naturally and understands that great sales begin with listening.



About the Role



Your job is to start conversations.



Not to pressure people.



Not to hard sell.



Your role is to build rapport, understand businesses, identify opportunities and arrange appointments for our advisers.



Success in this role comes from asking great questions, listening carefully and recognising when there is an opportunity to help a customer.



Your Responsibilities

Making outbound calls to UK businesses.

Speaking with business owners and senior decision makers.

Building rapport quickly.

Introducing Varissa professionally.

Asking thoughtful questions.

Understanding customer needs.

Identifying opportunities for our services.

Booking appointments for our advisers.

Following up previous conversations.

Updating HubSpot CRM.

Recording accurate call notes.

Helping improve our calling approach and sales processes.

The Person We're Looking For



You will probably:



Love talking to people.

Enjoy meeting new people.

Be naturally curious.

Listen more than you speak.

Ask intelligent questions.

Recognise opportunities that others miss.

Be persuasive without being pushy.

Think quickly.

Stay positive and enthusiastic.

Have resilience.

Enjoy learning.

Want to become a long-term member of our team.



We're not looking for someone who simply reads a script.



We're looking for someone who can have genuine business conversations and leave people wanting to know more.



Communication Skills



Excellent spoken English is essential.



You will spend much of your day speaking with UK business owners and professionals, so you must be confident, articulate and easy to understand.



We are looking for someone who:



Speaks fluent, natural English.

Has clear pronunciation.

Sounds confident and professional on the telephone.

Builds rapport quickly.

Is comfortable speaking with senior business people.

Can adapt their communication style to different personalities.

Sounds warm, engaging and trustworthy.



As almost all of our customers are based in the United Kingdom, applicants must have spoken English that is clear, neutral and naturally easy for UK customers to understand. We are not looking for an American-style accent or sales approach.



Your spoken English and telephone manner will form an important part of the interview process.



Experience



Previous experience in any of the following would be an advantage:



Telephone sales

Business development

Appointment setting

Customer service

Financial services

Banking

Vehicle finance

Commercial sales



However, personality, communication skills and attitude are more important than industry experience.



We can teach our products.



We cannot teach curiosity, enthusiasm or the ability to build rapport.



Working Hours

Approximately 10 hours per week initially.

Applicants must be available during UK morning business hours.

The role is expected to grow as the business grows.

Salary is paid monthly.

Technical Requirements



Applicants must have:



Reliable high-speed fibre internet.

A quiet, professional home office.

A modern Windows PC or laptop.

A minimum of two monitors/screens.

A good quality USB headset.

A webcam for Microsoft Teams meetings.



This role requires working across CRM software,
, research tools and customer information simultaneously, so a dual-screen setup is essential.



Please Note



This is a dedicated role.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our team.



Working for another employer during your agreed Varissa working hours will not be suitable.



How to Apply



Please send:



Your CV.

A short covering letter.

Your expected hourly rate.

Video Introduction (Required)



Please record a 60–90 second video (recorded on your phone is absolutely fine).



Please tell us:



About yourself.

Your previous experience.

Why you're interested in this role.

Why you believe you would be successful.

Why you enjoy speaking with people.



Please upload your video to Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or YouTube (Unlisted) and include the link with your application.



Please also answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about the best conversation you've ever had with a customer. Why did it go so well?



2. Imagine you call a business owner who says they aren't interested. Five minutes later they're still talking to you. What do you think you did differently?



3. Tell us about a time you persuaded someone to see something differently or consider an opportunity they hadn't previously thought about.



Finally, please include the words "Blue Umbrella" at the end of your application. Applications without this phrase will not be considered.

* Manage project timelines using project management software.

* Strong leadership skills with a proactive, ownership mindset.

* ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, or Trello

* Google Workspace

* Microsoft Office

* Notion

* Airtable

* Zapier or other automation tools

* CRM platforms (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, etc.)

The ideal candidate is:



* Detail-oriented

* Self-motivated

* Reliable and accountable

* Resourceful and proactive

* A strong communicator

* Focused on continuous improvement

title: Full-Time Video Editor (DaVinci Resolve) | Long-Term Role, Short-Form Now ? Grow to Long-Form
description:
I run the editing for several brands: a health & wellness client, my own brand, and other clients. I'm looking for one dedicated editor to help across my editing workflows: a mix of project types and video formats.



The base work is short-form video clip editing (vertical 9:16, cut from long-form footage and streams). Over time, my plan is for you to grow into full long-form editing as well. As things scale, the clipping may get outsourced again and you'd focus more on long-form, so this role keeps growing.



You'd be the one editor I build a workflow with, long-term. I want someone to grow with.



This is NOT a "clipper" job. Even the clipping work needs a real editor with an eye. Cutting a clip well means the audio feels natural, full word-endings, clean spacing, pacing that flows, background noise removed, consistent loudness. If your work is slapping captions onto soundbites in CapCut, this isn't for you. If you genuinely care how an edit feels, keep reading.



Why this role is different  (please read!)



This is a creative craft position, not a volume seat. You'll work directly under an experienced video director and learn a real editor's eye: pacing, listenability, how to make a talking-head cut feel human instead of machine-made. My standard is high (even on "simple" cuts)  and I'll teach you how to hit it, one skill at a time. The job isn't cranking out the most clips; it's producing consistently excellent work every month.



If you want to be pushed and grow into a genuinely skilled editor, this is a rare seat. If you want to run untouched templates fast, it isn't.



What you'll do



- Edit 80–100 short-form clips/month + 5–10 fuller edited videos (b-roll, motion graphics, color)

- Follow a documented brand style: fonts, caption animation, hook style, all provided

- Use Opus Clip (Pro, provided) to help select 
nts and set context, then finish in DaVinci Resolve

- Clean audio in DaVinci (noise removal, consistent loudness)

- Deliver to a shared Google Drive folder

- Grow into long-form editing over time



Must have



- DaVinci Resolve - required. It's what I edit in, so we share projects and workflow directly. (Premiere-only applicants, please don't apply for this one.)

- A genuine editor's eye for pacing and audio - show me you can make a talking-head cut feel natural

title: Technical Systems Architect & Automation Engineer
description:
JOB TITLE: Technical Systems Architect & Automation Engineer (Project Contract)



GEIZER GLOBAL is a boutique screening and intake agency. We do not wait for incoming inquiries. Instead, we identify, source, and qualify potential legal matters through our own structured processes. We vet each case through a strict qualification framework and prepare clean, accurate case files for law firms. We do not generate leads or operate as a marketing company; we provide a finished, vetted case file that has already passed through our internal standards. Our focus is accuracy, professionalism, and delivering high?quality case opportunities to firms that rely on consistent intake support. GEIZER GLOBAL operates with strict confidentiality and a commitment to clean, compliant processes.



GEIZER GLOBAL is hiring a Technical Systems Architect on a project contract to build a complete, human?exhaustive law?firm discovery and data?organization engine. This system must identify, cross?reference, verify, and organize every potential law firm in the United States that fits GEIZER GLOBAL’s business model. You are building the system, not operating it. Once the project is delivered and verified, the contract is complete. Estimated project completion time is 30 to 40 hours.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Build a full law?firm discovery engine using public directories, state bar listings, firm websites, hiring patterns, intake indicators, digital footprints, marketing signals, and business filings.

• Create cross?referencing logic that removes duplicates, verifies legitimacy, identifies practice areas, and flags firms with high intake capacity.

• Build a buyer?probability scoring model based on hiring signals, marketing activity, digital presence, and growth indicators.

• Deliver a CRM?ready database and a user?friendly dashboard (Airtable, Retool, or similar) that allows for searching, filtering, and exporting.

• Provide full technical documentation so the system can be operated independently.



WHAT THIS IS NOT

This project does not involve calling law firms, screening cases, intake work, sales, outreach, or marketing. This is a pure technical build.



REQUIRED SKILLS

• Python, scraping automation (Playwright/Puppeteer/Selenium), and API integrations.

• Advanced data cleaning and database architecture.

• Experience bypassing sophisticated anti?scraping measures.

• Ability to build clean, intuitive UI for data visualization.



COMPENSATION

$500–$800 range based on speed, quality, and complexity.

A $150–$300 performance bonus may be awarded if the syste
ets or exceeds all technical benchmarks and passes final verification.



TO APPLY

Send one message to 
 with:



1. A 3–5 sentence summary of the most complex automation system you’ve built.

2. A link to a GitHub repo or code sample.

3. A 60?second Loom video explaining your technical approach to building this discovery engine.

4. Your confirmed project rate.





---

title: Web Designer / Brand Designer - Figma + Branding
description:
Finding a good designer is hard.



Not because there are not enough people who can make something look nice. There are plenty of those.



We are looking for someone who can think through structure, layout, flow, and brand direction. Someone who understands that a website is not just a collection of pretty sections. It needs to guide people, make the next step clear, and feel like it belongs to the brand.



We are a small digital team building websites and brand systems for therapists, mental health practices, and other care-based businesses. Our work includes Figma designs, Squarespace websites, WordPress projects, and some custom-coded builds.



You would be joining our design team and reporting to our Head of Design.



This role is not for someone who only wants to make social media graphics. We need someone who can support real website design, branding, and client-facing projects.





WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON



You may help with:



>> Website layouts in Figma



>> Homepage and service page designs



>> Brand identity work



>> Logo concepts



>> Brand books / brand guides



>> Website sections and design systems



>> Design revisions based on team and client feedback



>> Squarespace projects, if you have experience or are willing to learn



>> Supporting active client projects alongside our design team



Some projects will be very structured. Others will require you to think through the layout and make smart design decisions.





WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



>> Strong Figma experience



>> Strong visual design and layout skills



>> Branding experience, including logo and brand book creation



>> A good eye for spacing, typography, hierarchy, and flow



>> Ability to read and follow briefs carefully



>> Ability to ask questions before going too far in the wrong direction



>> Ability to take feedback without getting defensive



>> Good communication and reliability



Squarespace experience is a strong plus, but it is not required.



If you are a strong designer and are willing to learn platforms like Squarespace, that matters more to us than already knowing every tool.





WHAT MATTERS HERE



A strong portfolio matters.



But the day-to-day work matters more.



We need someone who can slow down enough to understand the brief, ask questions when something is unclear, and check their own work before handing it off.



The goal is not just to finish tasks quickly. The goal is to create work that is thoughtful, accurate, and aligned with the direction of the project.



You do not need to know everything.



You do need to be eager to learn, open to feedback, and careful with details.





NICE TO HAVE



>> Squarespace experience



>> WordPress or Elementor familiarity



>> Experience designing for therapists, coaches, healthcare, wellness, or service-based businesses



>> Basic understanding of responsive web design







HOURS & PAY



>> Part-time



>> 15 to 20 hours per week



>> $6 to $7/hour depending on experience



>> Paid weekly



>> Initial 30-day probationary period



This is a long-term role for the right person.





HOW TO APPLY



Please
 your application directly to:







Use the subject line:



Web Designer / Brand Designer Application



Please include:



>> 2 to 3 of your strongest Figma website designs



>> 2 to 3 branding examples, logo concepts, or brand guide samples



>> Any Squarespace work, if you have it



>> A short explanation of your role in each project



>> A quick note on how you usually approach feedback and revisions





And one small catch:



Tell us who you are rooting for to win the World Cup.



Partly because we actually want to know. Partly because we want to make sure you read the full post.



Please do not send a generic application. We are looking for someone who can show how they think, not just send a list of tools.

Salary/Wage: $7-$16



We are looking for a highly execution-focused Senior Technical Developer to work directly with the founder and own the technical and systems layer of an enterprise project controls platform. Our platform replaces messy spreadsheets with a production-live system serving major multi-million dollar capital construction programs.  



This is a hands-on implementation role for an expert-level TypeScript and React developer who wants to build real-world ML/AI infrastructure (fine-tuned LLMs, voice interactive pipelines)—not just wrap basic APIs. There is zero corporate theater or management layers here ; you will build, test, and ship clean code directly to production.  



Main Responsibilities / Day-to-Day

- Full-Stack Feature Ownership: Autonomously decompose feature briefs, design structural technical architectures, and ship clean Pull Requests (PRs).  

- AI & Machine Learning Infrastructure: Build and maintain robust ML pipelines, covering training data preparation, fine-tuning scripts, and voice pipelines (STT/TTS).  

- Database & Backend Engineering: Write complex, raw PostgreSQL database schemas, advanced queries (CTEs, window functions), and handle data migrations with zero reliance on an ORM.  

 System Optimization: Develop, scale, and optimize high-throughput model inference steps and resolve backend production bugs.  



Essential Qualifications / Skills (Must-Haves)

- Strict TypeScript/JavaScript Mastery: 3+ years of production experience (generics, type inference, discriminated unions).  

- Production React & Next.js Literacy: Clear ownership over shipping live web apps using Next.js App Router (server vs. client components, middleware, route handlers).  

- Raw SQL Fluency: Expert with raw PostgreSQL; you do not use or need an ORM.  

- Python for Data/ML: Python proficiency explicitly tied to data preparation, training, and evaluation for machine learning pipelines.  

- Strict Git Workflow Discipline: Maintaining clean commits and structural code review habits.  

-Meticulous QA Mindset: You independently research unfamiliar stacks, test your own edge cases, and ensure work is right the first time.  



Preferred Skills (Nice-to-Haves)

- Hands-on PyTorch and Hugging Face model fine-tuning (PEFT/LORA, Transformers library).  

- Voice/speech ML engineering background (STT, TTS, or end-to-end voice pipeline tuning).  

- GPU infrastructure management capabilities (self-hosted GPU servers, CUDA, resource monitoring).  

- Front-end data visualization expertise (Tailwind CSS, Radix unstyled primitives, complex dashboard charting).  

- DevOps exposure (Docker containerization, multi-stage builds, and automated CI/CD pipelines).  





Ramp-Up Milestones

Day 30: Local environment running smoothly, 5–8 production PRs successfully merged, and full data tracing verified from the database to the UI.  

Day 60: Confidently writing raw SQL migrations, handling active production bugs, and launching initial LLM fine-tuning experiments.  

Day 90: Decomposing broad feature briefs into standalone technical tasks and actively contributing to voice AI and ML infrastructure pipelines.

title: QA Tester - Web App + iPhone Review
description:
We need detail-oriented QA testers for Carby, a meal-planning web app + iPhone app.



This is a small paid test first. Use this same submission form when invited:





IMPORTANT: start your application with MANGO so I know you read this.



What we learned from the last post:

- video evidence is more useful than long written opinions

- the first check should be short and easy to verify

- web app and iPhone app feedback should be separated

- do not test hidden payment/testing pages, coupon flows, or internal QA/operator routes



What I need from you:

1. Tell me your device access:

   - iPhone model + iOS version if you have one

   - if Android-only, say Android/mobile-web only

2. Tell me if you can record your phone screen with microphone audio.

3. Share one concrete bug or confusing app/web experience you found before.

   Include exact steps, expected result, actual result, and severity.

4. Confirm you can make a Google Doc report with video links, repro steps, severity, and screenshots/timestamps.



Paid test format:

- record a 3-minute tech check first on the web app using a phone browser with mic on

- then record a separate review for the actual iPhone app if you have iPhone access

- Android-only candidates can still do web app QA, but must clearly say they are web-only

- video is the primary evidence; I need to see the screen and hear what confused you

- the report must include exact repro steps, expected vs actual behavior, severity, and proof timestamps/screenshots

- include the word crispy in the severity section of the report



Good feedback:

- exact screen or step where it happened

- what you expected

- what actually happened

- why it could hurt signup, onboarding, trust, sign-in, meal-plan use, or grocery-list use

- timestamp/screenshot/video proof



Bad feedback:

- "looks good"

- broad design opinions with no steps

- old portfolio samples instead of this test

- issues from hidden/internal QA pages

- reporting cut-off/truncation without a timestamp or screenshot proving it



This is part
-based QA. Strong testers may get recurring QA work.

We’re hiring a Social Media Manager to own the strategy, coordination, and execution of social media distribution for some of the fastest-growing podcast brands on the internet. 



You will manage end-to-end social media execution across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram,

About Us: Event Strategies produces and owns a range of B2B event properties across a number of industry sectors in Ireland and the UK.



We specialise in planning and executing a wide range of events, from corporate conferences to social gatherings. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a talented and detail-oriented Sponsorship Delivery Executive to join our team and contribute to the success of our events.



Position Overview: As a Sponsorship Delivery Executive, you will play a pivotal role in managing and executing sponsorship packages for various events remotely. The ideal candidate will oversee sponsorship activation, maintain and strengthen client relationships, ensure brand compliance across event materials, track sponsorship deliverables, and oversee the creation of newsletters.



Important note: No second job. Full Irish office hours.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Sponsorship Activation:

• Develop and implement strategic plans to activate sponsorships across various marketing channels, maximizing sponsor visibility and audience engagement.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure sponsorship activation aligns with overall event goals and sponsor expectations.



2. Manage Client Relationships:

• Act as the main point of contact for sponsors, fostering strong, trust-based relationships through clear communication and mutual value creation.

• Conduct regular check-ins with sponsors to understand their needs, address concerns, and provide updates.

• Anticipate and proactively resolve any challenges during sponsorship agreements to ensure a smooth and positive experience.

• Provide timely feedback and approvals, collaborating with teams to ensure sponsor branding is accurately and consistently represented.

• Maintain a detailed tracking system to monitor the status of all sponsorship deliverables, ensuring timely and accurate fulfillment.

• Regularly update sponsors on the progress of deliverables and performance against key metrics.



5. Newsletter Creation:

• Work with the marketing team to craft compelling content and visuals for newsletters that resonate with sponsors and boost engagement.

• Analyze newsletter performance metrics and provide data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement.



6. Social Media Posts

• Create templated social media posts for sponsors and post in designated social media channels.



Qualifications:

• Proven experience in business client success / customer service is essential.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to thrive under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

• Strong organizational skills with a keen attention to detail.

• Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment.

• Proactive, with a demonstrated ability to take initiative and see tasks through to completion.



Benefits:

• Opportunities for career growth and development.

• Friendly and collaborative work environment.

• Exciting and diverse range of events to work on.



How to Apply: Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience to 
 include "Sponsorship Delivery Executive Application" in the subject line of your
. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.



Event Strategies is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.



We look forward to receiving your application and finding the right candidate to join our team and help us continue to deliver exceptional events!

title: Sales Manager
description:
JVDB Studios | Amsterdam, Netherlands



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Monday to Friday

Hours: 20 hours per week to start (Part-Time) with the opportunity to scale to 40 hours per week based on performance

Time Zone: Must have overlap with European/CET business hours

Compensation: Competitive base salary + uncapped commission



About JVDB Studios



JVDB Studios is a media and technology company based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. We are the team behind some of the world's largest creator brands, including Kwebbelkop and BlooGaming, which collectively reach more than 15 million subscribers globally.



Our CEO has built multiple successful digital businesses, generated billions of views across platforms, and continues to expand into new ventures within content, technology, licensing, and media distribution.



We are looking for a highly driven Senior Sales Manager / Commercial Lead who can take ownership of revenue-generating relationships across the business and work directly with the CEO to drive growth.



The Opportunity



This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for a proven closer who can build opportunities from scratch, develop relationships with decision-makers, and personally close deals.



You will own the full sales cycle across multiple business lines and play a key role in helping scale the company internationally. This role begins as a part-time position at 20 hours per week. Candidates who demonstrate strong execution, ownership, and the ability to consistently generate and close opportunities will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time role at 40 hours per week.



We believe in rewarding results. As you help grow the business, the role will grow alongside you.



What You'll Be Responsible For



You will own all revenue-generating relationships across the group, including brand partnerships, media licensing opportunities, FAST and OTT distribution partnerships, DubDash new business development, and creator service partnerships.



You will be responsible for building and managing your own pipeline, conducting outbound prospecting, qualifying opportunities, leading discovery and sales calls, creating proposals, negotiating commercial terms, closing deals, and ensuring a smooth handoff to operations. You will also maintain CRM accuracy, provide regular reporting, forecast revenue, and proactively identify risks and opportunities.



This position reports directly to the CEO with a dotted reporting line to the COO.



What We're Looking For



We are seeking someone with at least four years of B2B sales or business development experience and a demonstrated personal track record of closing consultative, multi-week sales opportunities. You should be able to show real numbers and revenue results from deals you have personally closed.



You must be comfortable owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close and be confident communicating with senior decision-makers across Europe, the United States, and the Middle East. Near-native business English, both written and verbal, is essential for this role.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, self-motivated, accountable, and capable of building systems and opportunities from scratch. We are looking for a self-starter who can operate independently while maintaining strong communication with leadership.



Candidates with experience in SaaS, media, creator economy businesses, content licensing, FAST channels, OTT distribution, or high-ticket B2B services will be viewed favorably, although these are not required.



This Role Is Not For You If



Your recent career has focused primarily on managing sales teams instead of personally closing deals. You have experience only in appointment setting or SDR roles without a proven closing record. You rely on company logos or network connections rather than demonstrated sales performance. You require a fully built-out system, extensive support, or a large team in order to succeed.



Why Join JVDB Studios



This is a unique opportunity to work directly with a founder who has built audiences of more than 15 million subscribers and multiple successful digital businesses. You will have direct access to leadership, exposure to international clients and partnerships, and the opportunity to play a key role in shaping the commercial future of a rapidly growing media company.



You will work in a fully remote environment with a Monday-to-Friday schedule and collaborate with partners and clients across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. The role offers uncapped commission potential and a clear path from a part-time position into a full-time opportunity for individuals who consistently deliver results.



How to Apply



Fill up this form -

Continuously improve script structure, pacing, hooks, and storytelling based on performance metrics.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Highly organized with excellent time management skills.



Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while meeting daily deadlines.

Professional growth within a fast-paced and innovative media company.

title: PostAI Account Manager (Customer Success + AI Video, English)
description:
PostAI Account Manager — Done-for-You AI Video + Customer Success

Full-time | Remote (work from home) | GMT+8 friendly

Pay: 25% commission per video (~S$10–20 each, uncapped), with a guaranteed minimum of S$400/month.



ABOUT POSTAI

PostAI is an AI platform that lets anyone create professional marketing videos in minutes. The problem: many of our users WANT great videos but don't have the time to make them. That's where you come in.



As a PostAI Account Manager, you become a small business owner inside PostAI. We assign you customers; you create their videos by using PostAI platform, so our users are hands free and you grow your own book of clients. The more value you create, the more you earn — your income is uncapped.



WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

The work we pay you for — running demos, helping customers, and recording short demo clips — is ALSO how you grow your own income. Every demo you host and every clip you record can bring you new clients. You simply upload your clips to a shared folder; our system posts and distributes everything automatically and credits the leads to you. You never publish anything yourself. You're not just an employee — you're building a business with PostAI's tools, brand, and customer pipeline behind you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Understand each customer's needs, then make their video. Talk with your assigned customers to capture exactly what they want, then log into their PostAI account (via secure delegated access) and create the video. PostAI is click-based — no prompt-writing or technical skill needed. Most videos take about 20 minutes. Once in a while a small CapCut tweak is needed, to make a professional video

- Customer success and demos. Chat with your customers, answer questions, and run "over-the-shoulder" guidance over screen share. Host Zoom sessions teaching people how to use PostAI — attendees can hire you directly.

- Record demo clips (we auto-post them for you). Record your sessions and turn each into 3–5 short screen-demo videos (about 1 minute each; longer for a feature walk-through). Just upload them to a shared folder — our system posts and distributes everything automatically and routes inbound leads back to you.

- Own your customers. Keep them happy, responsive, and coming back. Retained customers mean recurring commission for you.

-You need take role as customer support / customer success manager, answer enquires and run demo/workshop, thats the way you build trust and get more potential clients (who hire you to create their videos)



COMPENSATION

- Commission: 25% of each video's value — roughly S$10–20 per video — with NO cap. Each video is quick (about 20 min), so strong managers earn well above the minimum.

- Guaranteed minimum: S$400/month. How it works: if your total commission for the month is below S$400, we pay you S$400; if it's above S$400, you keep the full amount. You're always paid whichever is higher.

- Example: at just 5 videos/day you're already earning multiples of the minimum; top performers do far more.

- 1-month onboarding period, then ongoing full-time.



WHAT WE EXPECT (minimum monthly)

- Full-time availability (about 40 hrs/week) and replies to your customers within 0.5 business hours.

- At least 20 delivered videos/month (scaled to the number of customers assigned to you — if we send you fewer, the target adjusts).

- From your sessions, produce 3–5 short screen-demo clips (about 1 min each) and upload them to the shared folder. Posting is automatic.

title: Senior Para Broker / Credit Analyst – Australian Mortgage Broking
description:
Para Broker / Credit Analyst

Australian Mortgage Broking – Complex & Medical Lending

Applicants must have minimum 3 years experience analysing Australian mortgage lending scenarios.



Full-Time | Permanent | Work From Home

Salary: 70,000 – 100,000 PHP per month depending on experience



This Role Is For a Real Credit Analyst — Not a Broker Admin



We are an established Australian mortgage brokerage specialising in lending for medical professionals and complex borrowers. Our work regularly involves residential, investment, commercial, SMSF, trust structures, and high-net-worth lending.



We are looking for a genuinely experienced Para Broker or Credit Analyst who understands how to structure lending, interpret credit policy, and produce strong lender-ready applications.

If your previous role mainly involved preparing files for submission or acting as broker support, this position will not be the right fit.



The Type of Analyst We Are Looking For



You are someone who can think like a lender, not just process paperwork.



You have experience assessing borrowing capacity and servicing, identifying suitable lenders based on credit policy, structuring deals involving trusts, SMSF or commercial borrowers, and preparing clear credit submissions that help lenders approve deals.



You enjoy solving problems and working on lending scenarios where every file is different.



Mandatory Experience Requirements



Please only apply if you meet all of the following requirements.



You must have at least 3 years experience as a Para Broker or Credit Analyst in Australian mortgage broking.



You must have experience analysing and structuring residential and investment lending.



Exposure to commercial lending, trust lending or SMSF lending is highly desirable.



You must have strong knowledge of Australian lender credit policy and excellent written and spoken English.



You must also have experience using the following platforms:



ApplyOnline (AOL)

Mercury CRM

Quickli



If you are unfamiliar with these systems, you are not qualified for this role.



What You Will Be Doing



Analysing client financials and servicing positions



Researching lender credit policy and structuring lending solutions



Recommending lenders and loan strategies to brokers



Preparing high quality credit submissions



Assisting with complex lending scenarios including SMSF and trust structures



Supporting files through to approval and settlement



You will work closely with experienced brokers who handle complex transactions, so your work will directly influence deal outcomes.



Why This Role Is Different



Many offshore roles in mortgage broking are administrative.



This role is not.



You will be working with brokers who specialise in complex and high-value lending, including medical professional lending, SMSF lending, trust lending, commercial lending, and high-net-worth borrowers.



We value intelligence, initiative, strong analytical ability and attention to detail.



If you enjoy working on challenging deals and learning advanced lending strategy, you will thrive in this environment.



What We Offer



Permanent full-time work from home role



Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm AEST



Salary between 70,000 and 100,000 PHP depending on experience



A small experienced team of high-performing brokers and analysts



Exposure to complex lending scenarios most analysts never see



We are building a long-term team and are looking for someone who wants to grow with the business.



Application Instructions (Important)



Please do not send a CV only.



Applications without the following will not be reviewed.



Record a short video introduction (2 to 4 minutes) where you:



Explain your experience as a Credit Analyst or Para Broker



Describe the types of lending scenarios you have worked on



Explain how your role differed from broker administration or loan processing



Demonstrate your spoken English communication



Upload the video to Google Drive or YouTube (unlisted) and include the link in your application.



Failure to follow these instructions will result in automatic rejection as attention to detail is critical in this role.



If you are an experienced credit analyst who enjoys problem-solving, complex lending structures and working with high-performing professionals, we would like to hear from you.

title: AI Search & Visibility Specialist (GEO + SEO)
description:
— This is NOT a traditional SEO role. Please read carefully before applying. —



About the Role

Search has fundamentally changed. Buyers no longer just Google — they ask ChatGPT, query Perplexity, and rely on Google AI Overviews to make decisions. At Calimingo Pools, a luxury pool design and construction company based in Southern California, we want to be the brand AI recommends when someone starts dreaming about their backyard.

We're hiring an AI Search & Visibility Specialist who lives at the intersection of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and traditional search. You understand how large language models retrieve, rank, and cite information — and you know how to get a brand into those answers. Traditional SEO is your foundation, not your ceiling.

This is a freelance, remote role with real ownership over how Calimingo is discovered across every search surface — from Google rankings to AI-generated responses.



?? Who This Role Is NOT For



Candidates who only know traditional SEO and have never worked with AI search platforms

Candidates who cannot name the difference between how Google indexes content vs. how an LLM retrieves and cites it

Candidates who have not actively used tools like Perplexity, ChatGPT, or Google AI Overviews as part of their professional work





What You'll Do



Own Calimingo's full search visibility strategy — from Google rankings to AI-generated answers

Conduct GEO and SEO audits covering AI discoverability, citation potential, technical health, and content structure

Optimize pages and content for LLM readability — answer-first formats, clear heading hierarchies, passage-level clarity that AI engines can extract and cite

Build topical authority and entity signals so both search engines and AI tools associate Calimingo with luxury pools, pool design, and outdoor living

Implement schema markup (FAQPage, Product, Article, Organization) for rich results and AI citation

Monitor and grow Calimingo's citation presence across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Microsoft Copilot, and Gemini

Pursue earned media placements — directories, review platforms, editorial features — that strengthen both backlinks and AI multi-source authority

Manage technical search fundamentals — crawlability, page speed, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, site architecture

Publish and maintain content directly on the Calimingo website via WordPress

Report monthly on organic rankings, AI citation frequency, and share of voice vs. competitors





Must-Have Skills



Hands-on GEO experience — you have actively worked to get brands cited in AI-generated answers, not just read about it

Working knowledge of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) — you understand why it matters for brand visibility

Fluency with AI platforms — you regularly use ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot, and Gemini as professional tools, not just casually

AI visibility tracking — experience with tools like Otterly.ai, Ahrefs Brand Radar, BrightEdge, or similar

Traditional SEO foundation — keyword research, on-page optimization, link building, technical audits

Schema markup — FAQPage, Product, Article, Organization

Search tools — Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Search Console

WordPress — confident navigating, editing, and publishing on a live website

Content strategy — semantic architecture, entity-based strategy, topical authority building





Nice to Have



Digital PR and earned media experience

Knowledge graph and E-E-A-T optimization

Familiarity with agentic search (OpenAI Operator) and agent-driven discovery

Experience with home improvement, construction, luxury goods, or lifestyle brands





To Apply, Please Answer These Questions

Applications without answers will not be reviewed.



Have you worked on a GEO strategy before? If yes, describe one specific result — ideally a brand you helped get cited in an AI-generated answer and how you did it.

What tools do you currently use to monitor AI citations and brand visibility across AI platforms?

What is RAG and why does it matter for a brand trying to appear in AI search answers?

What's one difference between optimizing content for Google vs. optimizing it for an LLM?





What Success Looks Like

Within 90 days: a comprehensive audit, a prioritized roadmap, and early improvements in how Calimingo appears in both Google results and AI-generated responses. Long term: Calimingo is the brand AI tools reach for when someone searches "luxury pool builders" or asks ChatGPT where to start.
