title: Creator Research and Outreach Virtual Assistant
description:
Voyage is a growth agency that builds digital products for creators. We partner with creators to turn their expertise into mobile and subscription apps that their audience can buy and use, for example a fitness app built around a trainer's programs and coaching. We are looking for a reliable, self-directed virtual assistant to build our creator prospect lists and prepare outreach for these partnerships.



You will not be sending messages or joining calls. Your role covers everything that leads up to that: finding creators who fit our criteria, qualifying them properly, and drafting personalised outreach that reads naturally. We handle the outreach from there.



Because we build products out of a creator's knowledge, the creators we target must have real, teachable expertise. Think coaches, instructors, and educators who genuinely teach their audience something, not accounts that are mainly about looks or lifestyle.



This role will suit someone who is comfortable researching across Instagram and TikTok, has a good eye for quality, and can write clear, natural English.



## What you will do



* Build prospect lists from a defined brief, covering platform, engagement quality, content type, and audience fit

* Qualify each creator properly rather than relying on numbers alone. This means watching their content, checking whether they present well to camera, and assessing whether they have a genuine connection with their audience

* Record the key details in a lead tracker (we will set this up with you)

* Identify the best way to contact each creator and note it

* Draft a short, personalised outreach
 for each qualified creator, referencing something specific about them rather than generic praise

* Keep the pipeline organised and hand over clean, ready-to-use leads and drafts



As a guide, we expect around 7 to 10 qualified creators per day, allowing roughly 15 to 20 minutes to qualify each one properly. Quality of fit matters more than volume.



## Who you are



* Excellent written English. This is essential, as your drafts need to read naturally and professionally

* Confident and efficient navigating Instagram and TikTok, with a good sense of what makes a creator's audience engaged

* Strong research skills. You verify information and do not simply rely on the first result you find

* Organised and accurate. The lead tracker stays clean and correct

* Self-directed. Once you understand the brief, you can work independently without close supervision



## Nice to have



* Experience with influencer or creator research tools (Social Blade, Modash, HypeAuditor, or similar)

* A background in social media, marketing, or partnerships

* Familiarity with Airtable, Notion, or Google Sheets for tracking





## The details



Fully remote

Part-time to start, around 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a larger role

A few hours of daily overlap with New Zealand business hours (NZST)

Rate: USD $5 to $7 per hour, depending on experience

Paid trial before we commit, so both sides can confirm the fit



## How to apply



Please submit your application through our application form: 



Complete both steps below. We only consider applications that include both, submitted via the form above.



1. Record a 60-second video. Introduce yourself, outline your relevant experience, and explain why you are a good fit for this role. It does not need to be polished. We simply want to see how you communicate.



2. Complete a short screening task. Using the brief below, find two creators who fit and draft the outreach
 you would send to one of them.



Context for the task: Voyage builds mobile apps for creators, turning their expertise into a product their audience can buy and use. So we are looking for creators with genuine, teachable skill, whose knowledge could become an app such as a training program, coaching, or structured course.



## Brief for the task:



Platform: Instagram or TikTok

Niche: women's fitness or wellness

Followers: 100k to 250k

Audience: mostly women aged 30 to 45

Must have: educational or instructional content that shows real expertise. For example, a coach breaking down technique, a trainer sharing programs, or an instructor teaching a method

Not a fit: accounts that are mainly modelling, aesthetics, or lifestyle, with no teachable skill behind them



For each creator, provide their handle, their approximate follower count, one line on why their audience looks engaged, and one line on what expertise of theirs could become an app. Then write the outreach
 for one of them, introducing the idea of us building an app around their expertise.



We are not expecting perfection. We want to understand how you think and whether you can follow a brief.

description:

As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the executive office. Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.

Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels.

• Proactive problem solver and resourceful thinker.

• High-speed internet connection to support video calls, cloud-based collaboration, and remote work.

If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its tea

/internationalcareers

title: Performance Video Editor – Direct Response Ads
description:
PERFORMANCE VIDEO EDITOR — DIRECT RESPONSE ADS (Full-Time, Remote)





ABOUT US



We are LederKur. One of the biggest direct-to-consumer leather and wood care brands in the entire DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland). Six figures. Thousands of customers. Scaling hard with Meta Ads every single month.



We are not a startup trying to figure things out. We know what works. We have winning ads, winning scripts, and a proven system. What we need is someone who can turn those scripts into scroll-stopping video creatives. Fast. Clean. Consistently.



This is not a corporate video role. This is performance marketing. Every video you create has one job: make people stop scrolling, watch, and buy.





WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT



You will not be guessing what to make. You will receive ready-made scripts with proven copy. Reference videos that show you exactly the style we want. Product footage you can use. And direct feedback from the founder on what is working and what is not.



Your job is execution. Take the script. Find the right clips. Cut the video. Deliver it clean. Repeat.



No meetings. No politics. No layers. Just you, the script, and the timeline.





WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Receive ready-made ad scripts from the founder

- Source all clips yourself (stock footage, UGC-style footage, AI-generated clips)

- Edit and deliver 20 to 25 finished ad creatives per week (full edits from scratch plus variations like hook swaps, new intros, format changes, CTA tests)

- Create different ad formats: UGC-style ads, VSLs (Video Sales Letters), native-style video ads

- Add captions, text overlays, transitions, and sound design

- Follow direct response best practices: strong hook in the first 2 seconds, pattern interrupts, clean pacing, clear CTAs

- Deliver final files optimized for Meta Ads (9:16, 1:1, 4:5)

- Iterate quickly based on performance feedback

- Build and maintain an organized clip library

- Use AI voiceover tools like ElevenLabs to generate German voiceovers from provided scripts





WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



- Minimum 2 years experience editing performance ads for DTC or e-commerce brands (not brand films, not wedding videos, not corporate content)

- Expert-level video editing skills. Use whatever software you want. CapCut, After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve. We do not care about the tool. We care about the output.

- A portfolio that shows real direct response ad creatives that were built to sell

- IMPORTANT: All our videos are in German. All captions, text overlays, and on-screen copy are in German. You do not need to speak German. You will receive all text ready to use. Your job is to place it correctly with zero spelling or formatting errors.

- Ability to source clips on your own. You will not be told where to find footage. You find it yourself or you generate it with AI.

- Consistent speed: 20 to 25 creatives per week is the standard

- Reliable internet and your own editing setup

- Good written communication in English

- Ownership mentality: you take full responsibility for quality and deadlines. No excuses. No hand-holding.





NICE TO HAVE



- Understanding or speaking German (big plus, not required)

- Experience with AI video tools (Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance)

- Experience with ElevenLabs or other AI voiceover tools

- Motion graphics and animation skills

- Experience editing ads for the German or European market

- Basic understanding of Meta Ads metrics (CTR, hook rate, hold rate)





COMPENSATION



- $5 per hour USD (full-time, 40 hours per week)

- Full-time remote position

- Performance bonuses for creatives that deliver strong results

- Long-term role with room to grow as the brand scales

- Salary increases based on performance reviews





WORK SETUP



- Fully remote

- Full-time (40 hours per week)

- Must have overlap with European business hours (CET) for daily communication

- Fast-paced, high-output environment. We test constantly and iterate quickly.

- You communicate directly with the founder. No middlemen.





HOW TO APPLY



Send the following:



1. Your portfolio or showreel. Must include direct response ad creatives you have personally edited. Not team projects. Not brand films. Your work.



2. A short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes maximum) where you explain:

   - How long you have been editing performance ads

   - Your process when you receive a script

   - One example from your portfolio: what was the goal, what did you do, what was the result



3. Your expected hourly rate in USD



4. Your earliest available start date



5. Your current editing setup (computer specs, internet speed, software)





IMPORTANT — READ THIS:



To confirm you have read this entire post, write our brand name in the FIRST LINE of your application. Not somewhere in the middle. Not at the end. The first line.



If you do not know our brand name, you did not read the post. Applications without it will be ignored. No exceptions.





We are not looking for someone who can edit videos. We are looking for someone who can make ads that sell. If that is you, apply today.

title: YouTube Thumbnail Artist Needed
description:
My name is Rick, and we are scaling a network of YouTube automation channels. 



We are looking for a thumbnail artist who can create strong, clickable YouTube thumbnails for our channels.



You can use AI tools to create thumbnails, or you can create them from scratch if that is your preferred workflow. The most important thing is that the final thumbnails look professional, match the video topic, and are designed to get clicks.



The topics, titles, channel style, and creative direction will be provided.



We prefer someone who already understands YouTube thumbnails, curiosity, contrast, facial expressions, simple layouts, readable text, and what makes someone stop scrolling and click.



Examples: 



Main Responsibilities



• Create strong YouTube thumbnails using AI tools, design software, or your own creative workflow.



• Output: 5 to 6 thumbnails per working day.



• Follow the provided title, topic, channel style, and thumbnail instructions.



• Create thumbnails that are clear, clickable, and easy to understand on mobile, desktop, and TV.



• Use strong composition, facial expressions, colours, contrast, and readable text.



• Make sure each thumbnail matches the video topic and does not feel random or generic.



• Create thumbnails that look polished and not obviously AI-generated.



• Make revisions when requested.



• Follow the provided SOPs, examples, and channel guidelines.



## Position Details



• Role: YouTube Thumbnail Artist.



• Output: Approximately five to six thumbnails per working day.



• Tools: AI tools, Photoshop, Canva, Midjourney, Ideogram, Leonardo, ChatGPT, or any other tools you prefer.



• Compensation: $150 USD per month.



• Long-term role for someone reliable and consistent.



## Requirements



• Experience creating YouTube thumbnails.



• Good understanding of clickable thumbnail design.



• Ability to use AI tools or design software to create strong thumbnail concepts.



• Ability to follow references and match an existing channel style.



• Good eye for layout, text placement, contrast, facial expressions, and visual clarity.



• Able to make thumbnails that look professional, not cheap or generic.



• Reliable and able to complete thumbnails quickly.



## Ideal Candidate



You understand that a good thumbnail should create curiosity immediately.



You know how to keep thumbnails simple, bold, and easy to read.



You can use AI, design tools, or create from scratch, but you also know when a thumbnail needs improving.



You are comfortable following an existing channel style instead of creating something completely different every time.



## How to Apply (If you do not read the full job post you are less likely to receive a response) 



1. Start your application with your favourite animal.



2. Send examples of thumbnails you have created.



3. Send links to YouTube videos where your thumbnails were used.



4. Briefly explain what tools you use to create thumbnails.



5. Tell us whether you use AI tools, create thumbnails from scratch, or use a mixture of both.



6. Confirm that you can follow existing channel styles and make revisions when needed.



7. Confirm that you understand the compensation is $150 USD per month.

title: 3D Sculptor / 3D Artist Wanted (Blender,ZBrush, Nomad, etc.) — $5/hr + $7 Per Model Bonus, Long-Term
description:
Hi, I'm Rick! I run a growing 3D printing product business in the US, and the modeling workload has outgrown what I can handle alone. I'm looking for a talented sculptor to become my go-to artist for the long haul. Test jobs start immediately.





The work: I use AI tools to generate rough 3D models that arrive 70 to 90% finished on average. Most jobs are polishing and fixing these to match reference images, some are sculpting from scratch, and some are more complex pieces. Think characters and creatures, animals, figurines, seasonal decor, props, and plenty that doesn't fit any category. Styles vary from project to project, so comfort working in different looks is important. Knowing 3D printing basics (overhangs, supports, thickness) is a plus, but not a requirement.



Each job comes with: the rough 3D model, reference images, and notes, plus its own due date. No guesswork, no vague briefs.



You deliver: the finished model as an STL plus your source file, correctly scaled and ready to print. Jobs include up to 2 revisions, though most will need zero, and revision time counts as paid hours like any other work. All delivered work belongs to my business and can't be shared, posted, or reused elsewhere.



Timelines: every job card shows its due date up front, most a day or two out, with bigger sculpts getting more time. Some jobs are time-sensitive and marked priority, and those need to come first. Since models arrive mostly finished, most jobs take 30 minutes to 2 hours of actual work, so due dates are easy to hit if you're working steadily. Ever need more time? Just tell me before the due date, early communication is always fine.



The pay, kept simple:

$5 for every hour you work, PLUS a $7 bonus every time you finish a model.



Finish a model in an hour and you made $12 that hour

Finish 10 models in a week and that's $70 in bonuses on top of all your hourly pay



The bonus pays when the model is approved, meaning it matches the reference. If something's off, that's what revisions are for, and the bonus still pays once it's fixed. The faster you work, the more you earn, with no ceiling. At normal speed that's $10 to $14/hr effective. Paid every Friday through EasyPay, no exceptions, no delays.



Volume is 10 to 15 models a week right now, roughly 10 to 20 hours of part-time work, and growing fast toward Q4. As we get in sync, I keep jobs queued up on your board so there's always a next model waiting, no dead time between tasks. If you can handle the workflow, the work keeps coming. My goal is one reliable artist I send everything to, and for the right person this grows from part-time into full-time work. Prove you can handle it and I won't need to hire anyone else.



Why people like working with me:



Full flexibility. Work whenever you want, day or night. I only care that jobs hit their due dates.



Zero micromanaging. No meetings, no calls, no check-ins. Do the work well and you'll barely hear fro
 except "approved" and payments.



Clear specs, every time. References and notes mean you always know what "done" looks like.



Reliable pay. Every Friday, on time, every time.



How we'll work together: jobs arrive on a simple Trello board. Quick "got it" when you pick one up, deliver the file to the card when done. Job questions happen on the card, general chat over 
. TimeProof runs for timekeeping only, so hours count themselves with no timesheets and no disputes.



What I'm looking for: strong organic sculpting (Blender, ZBrush, Nomad, or similar), clean print-ready meshes, comfortable across styles, good written English.



The hiring process: shortlisted applicants get two small paid test jobs ($5 each), real work and real pay, never free labor. Testing starts right away, and the best performer becomes my main artist.





To apply, answer all 4:



1. Your portfolio, as much as you can, especially recent work. Show me your range, from quick pieces to your most complex sculpts.



2. Which sculpting software you use and how long you've been sculpting.



3. Any experience designing for 3D printing? Overhangs, supports, wall thickness, slicers, anything along those lines. If you've printed your own work, even better. It's a plus, not a requirement.



4. Your availability, hours per week you're looking for.



5. Why do you think you'd be a good fit for this? A few honest sentences, no essay needed.



Applications missing any of these won't be considered.

title: Accounting Executive
description:
About Scriveiner

Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories. Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day.



The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King’s Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards.



Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences.





The Opportunity

Scriveiner is at a pivotal point in its growth expanding into new premium product categories, scaling its Amazon and Shopify channels, and building the operational infrastructure to support a significant step-change over the next three years. As the business grows, so does the need for a finance function that is not just accurate, but sharp.



We are hiring an Accounting Executive to sit at the operational core of the Finance team. This is a role for someone who understands UK accounting deeply, works confidently without a manual, and brings the kind of proactive judgment that means problems get spotted before they become problems. The Finance Manager is looking for someone who improves how the function works not just someone who keeps pace with it.



Day to day, you will own the transactional engine of the business: AP, AR, bank reconciliations, VAT, month-end close, and the accuracy behind every financial report we produce. But the expectation goes further than execution. You will look at how we do things, identify where they can be tighter, and take genuine ownership of the financial integrity of a lean, fast-moving business. The systems you help build now will underpin Scriveiner at twice its current size.



What You Will Own

Own the accuracy and completeness of daily financial transactions, AP, AR, invoicing, and payment runs ensuring every entry is correctly authorised, coded, and filed

Lead bank and supplier reconciliations, resolving discrepancies proactively rather than waiting for month-end to surface them

Take full ownership of VAT preparation and filing support, maintaining compliance with UK regulations

Drive month-end and year-end close activities, moving the process forward with minimal direction

Maintain clean audit trails across all financial records digital and physical so documentation is always ready, not assembled at the last minute

Identify gaps and inefficiencies in current financial processes and bring forward practical improvements you are expected to flag what is not working and suggest what should replace it

Support the preparation of management accounts, P&L summaries, cash flow reports, and balance sheet reconciliations that the Finance Manager and founders can rely on

Liaise with internal teams and external suppliers on financial queries, acting as a reliable point of contact who resolves issues without escalation

Contribute to forecasting and budgeting inputs as the business plans for growth across new product categories and marketplaces

Perform intercompany reconciliations, ensuring transactions between business entities are accurately recorded and resolved in a timely manner

Assist in the preparation of divisional profit and loss accounts, supporting clear visibility of performance across the business

Ensure correct expense allocation across business divisions, maintaining accuracy and consistency in how costs are assigned and reported





Who You Are

Essential — you must have this:

Solid, hands-on UK accounting experience you understand VAT, AP/AR workflows, reconciliations, and month-end close as second nature

Proven proficiency with at least one major accounting platform: Xero, QuickBooks, or Sage

Strong Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and basic data modelling without needing to be shown

A track record of working independently, you manage your own workload, flag risks early, and do not require close supervision to maintain accuracy

A genuine drive to improve how a finance function works, not just maintain it  you notice inefficiencies and act on them

High attention to detail with a professional approach to confidentiality and financial data

Experience working within a business with a turnover of £10 million or more





Desirable — it would strengthen your application if you have this:

Familiarity with e-commerce accounting, particularly Amazon Seller Central or Shopify financial flows

Experience working in a small or scaling business where finance is a lean, high-ownership function

Exposure to multi-currency transactions or international marketplace accounting





What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will be successful when:

Financial records are consistently accurate, up to date, and audit-ready without prompting

Bank and supplier reconciliations are completed on time with discrepancies identified and resolved proactively

VAT filings and compliance obligations are met without error or delay

Month-end close is completed efficiently, with reports the Finance Manager and founders can rely on

You bring forward at least one meaningful improvement to financial processes or systems within your first 90 days

The Finance Manager spends less time checking and more time using the information you produce

title: VIDEO EDITOR FOR PODCAST + VIRAL SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT
description:
VIDEO EDITOR FOR PODCAST + VIRAL SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT



???? PAY



$100 USD per completed project



This is NOT an hourly position.



We pay based on completed deliverables, not the number of hours it takes.



If you're efficient, organized, and produce exceptional work, you'll have the opportunity to complete more projects and increase your earnings over time.



Each completed project includes:



• One fully edited podcast episode (typically 1–2 hours in length)

• One mastered audio version

• One full podcast video with captions

• Five high-performing vertical videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

• Up to 2 rounds of revisions (requested within 7 days of delivery)



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term part of our growing media company.





ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for a creative, highly skilled, and reliable video editor who wants to help build a world-class podcast brand.



This is much more than simply cutting footage together.



We are looking for someone who understands storytelling, viewer psychology, pacing, emotion, and how to keep audiences watching until the very end.



You should understand that every second matters.



Every cut.

Every zoom.

Every sound effect.

Every pause.

Every caption.



...should have a purpose.



Our goal is to create some of the highest-quality podcast content on YouTube and social media.





OUR INSPIRATION



One of our biggest inspirations is Diary of a CEO.



Before applying, please watch at least three full episodes and study the editing.



Pay close attention to:



• Opening hooks

• Curiosity gaps

• Open loops

• Emotional storytelling

• Cinematic pacing

• Strategic zooms

• Music placement

• Sound design

• Tension and release

• Retention psychology



We're not looking to copy their style.



We're looking for someone who understands WHY viewers stay engaged.



If you understand the psychology behind great editing, you'll fit in well with our team.





ABOUT OUR BRAND



You will be editing content for Christy Love.



Christy's brand is unlike anyone else's.



She is an:



• Adult entertainer

• Ordained pastor

• Stand-up comedian

• Author

• Podcast host



Her podcast, In Bed with Christy Love, features comedians, actors, entrepreneurs, influencers, adult industry personalities, athletes, and guests with extraordinary life stories.



The show explores conversations most people are afraid to have.



Topics include:



• Success

• Failure

• Faith

• Comedy

• Sex

• Addiction

• Trauma

• Relationships

• Mental health

• Personal growth

• Redemption

• Human psychology



The goal is to make people laugh...



Think...



Feel...



And walk away seeing the world differently.





CURRENT REACH



• 250,000+ followers across social media

• Approximately 8 million monthly views



We are investing heavily into growing this brand over the next several years.



We're looking for people who want to grow with us.





WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



Each week you'll edit approximately:



• 2–3 podcast episodes



Each episode is generally between 1 and 2 hours long.





DELIVERABLES PER PROJECT



Each completed project includes:



• One professionally edited podcast video

• One professionally mastered podcast audio file

• One full podcast video with captions

• Five high-performing vertical videos

• Exported files ready for publishing

• Organized project files (if requested)





RESPONSIBILITIES



You'll be responsible for:



• Editing long-form podcast episodes

• Synchronizing multiple camera angles

• Removing mistakes, interruptions, filler words, and unnecessary dead space

• Improving pacing and overall viewer retention

• Creating compelling opening hooks

• Building curiosity throughout the episode

• Enhancing audio quality

• Balancing audio levels

• Adding intro, commercial, and outro sequences

• Creating engaging captions

• Delivering five viral-ready short-form clips

• Meeting weekly deadlines consistently





VISUAL EDITING REQUIREMENTS



We want every episode to feel polished, cinematic, and premium.



You should be comfortable with:



• Multi-camera editing

• Color correction

• Color grading

• White balance adjustments

• Exposure correction

• Brightness and contrast adjustments

• Skin tone correction

• Image sharpening

• Creating a polished cinematic look





AUDIO EDITING REQUIREMENTS



Audio quality is extremely important.



You should know how to:



• Reduce background noise

• Clean dialogue

• Balance audio levels

• Remove distracting pauses

• Improve clarity

• Deliver professional-quality podcast audio





RETENTION PSYCHOLOGY



This is one of the most important parts of this position.



We aren't looking for someone who simply edits.



We're looking for someone who understands why people continue watching.



You should understand concepts like:



• Retention psychology

• Curiosity loops

• Pattern interrupts

• Open loops

• Emotional storytelling

• Building tension

• Releasing tension

• Watch-time optimization

• Hook creation



You should constantly ask yourself:



"How do I keep the viewer watching another 30 seconds?"





CREATING VIRAL CLIPS



Every podcast should produce five outstanding short-form videos.



We're looking for clips with real viral potential.



You should be able to identify:



• Funny 
nts

• Emotional 
nts

• Vulnerable 
nts

• Shocking statements

• Powerful stories

• Unexpected reactions

• Inspirational advice

• Controversial opinions



The goal is simple:



Make people stop scrolling.





TURNAROUND TIME



We publish multiple episodes every week.



Meeting deadlines is critical.



Expected turnaround:



• Full podcast edit: 48–72 hours

• Five short-form clips: 24–48 hours after podcast approval

• Revisions: Within 24 hours whenever reasonably possible



If you already have multiple clients, that's completely fine.



However, you must have enough availability to consistently meet these deadlines.





REVISIONS



Each project includes:



• Up to 2 rounds of revisions

• Revision requests will be submitted within 7 days of delivery.

• Revisions should be completed within 24 hours whenever reasonably possible.



If additional revisions are requested because of a significant creative change (rather than correcting mistakes), additional compensation may be discussed.





SOFTWARE



Any professional editing software is welcome, including:



• Adobe Premiere Pro

• DaVinci Resolve

• Final Cut Pro

• CapCut

• Or equivalent professional editing software





BONUS SKILLS



These are not required but highly valued:



• Motion graphics

• Sound design

• Advanced color grading

• YouTube optimization

• Viral short-form editing

• Experience editing podcasts similar to Diary of a CEO





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



• Creative

• Detail-oriented

• Reliable

• Communicative

• Self-motivated

• Passionate about storytelling

• Obsessed with creating exceptional content



We're not interested in someone who simply completes tasks.



We're looking for someone who wants to help build something special.





HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



• A short introduction about yourself

• Links to podcast episodes you've edited

• Examples of Reels, TikToks, or Shorts you've created

• Your favorite editing software

• Your internet upload speed

• Your internet download speed

• Your computer processor

• Your computer RAM





PAID EDITING TEST



Finalists will be asked to complete a paid editing test using footage from one of our podcast episodes.



This allows both you and our team to determine if we're the right fit before moving into a long-term working relationship.





APPLICATION FILTER



To confirm you've read this entire posting, please begin the FIRST LINE of your application with the word:



LIPS



Applications that do not include this word will not be considered.





FINAL NOTE



We believe editing is one of the most important parts of storytelling.



Great editing doesn't just make a video look better.



It makes people feel something.



If you're someone who genuinely loves storytelling, understands audience psychology, takes pride in your work, communicates well, meets deadlines, and wants to help build a world-class media brand, we'd love to hear from you.



Please message me on 



If you do not have Instagram, please do not apply.

title: Full-Time Video Editor- Strong Storyteller | Social, Brand, Ads & YouTube
description:
Full-Time Video Editor Wanted - ScreenGrab Video Marketing

Location: Remote (Philippines preferred) | Type: Full-time | Rate: NZ$1,800-2,200/month (trial), with a clear path to NZ$2,500+ as you prove yourself. 



Hey, thanks for checking us out 

We're Screengrab, a video production and content marketing agency based in Auckland, New Zealand. 



We work with awesome businesses across property, finance, engineering, trades (builders, plumbers etc...) and retail to create content that actually gets results, not just videos that look nice and go nowhere. We're growing fast, building out long-term client partnerships, and we need a talented editor to join us for the long haul, not just a quick project here and there.



The Role

We're after a full-time video editor who's more than just technically solid, we want someone who gets story. Someone who can take a pile of raw footage and just know what to cut, what to keep, and where the heart of the piece actually is. If you've got that instinct, we'd love to hear from you.



You won't be stuck doing the same thing every day either. The work is genuinely varied, so you'll get to flex different creative muscles:

Social media reels: punchy, fast, built to stop the scroll

Brand videos: polished, story-led pieces that showcase who our clients are

Paid ads 
/Instagram/YouTube): built to convert, not just impress

YouTube long-form content: pacing, chaptering, and keeping people watching

Everything in between: interviews, testimonials, case studies, behind-the-scenes content

We're not going to hand you a rigid template every time. We want someone who can read a brief, understand what we're actually trying to achieve, and bring their own creative judgment to the table.



What You'll Be Doing

Editing a solid volume of video content across a few different client projects at once

Making your own creative and structural calls on pacing and story, not just following a shot list

Adding motion graphics, text, sound design, and colour grading where it's needed

Keeping your footage and project files organised and easy to navigate

Talking to us proactively, flagging anything that's unclear, giving us realistic timelines

Taking feedback in stride and turning it around quickly without losing quality



What We're Looking For



The must haves:

A genuine eye for story. We'll ask you to point us to specific 
nts in your reel where you made a call that lifted the footage, not just executed a brief.

Great written and spoken English. You'll be talking with us directly, and sometimes with clients too, so clear communication really matters.

Strong skills in Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve (bonus points for After Effects and motion graphics)

Fast, reliable internet and a computer that can handle 4K footage without grinding to a halt

Good storage set up on your end: a reliable external drive or SSD with enough room for active projects and footage, and a proper backup habit so nothing ever gets lost. We'll set you up with shared cloud storage too, but we need to know your home base is solid.



Nice to haves:

Experience editing specifically for social platforms, not just long-form or broadcast

A track record editing for real clients/businesses, not just personal projects

Comfort working async across time zones, with clear and proactive updates



How We'll Get to Know You

Send us your reel, plus a quick note on 2-3 
nts where your editing choices made a real difference.

A small paid test project: a real brief with real footage, so we can see how you actually work.

A quick video call, just to chat through how you work and say hello properly.



Pay & How We'll Grow It Together

First 30 days (trial): NZ$1,500-1,800/month, working on real client projects

After the trial: NZ$1,800-2,200/month

90 day check in: if you're consistently delivering great, story-driven work across multiple clients, we'll happily talk about moving toward NZ$2,500-3,500+ as you take on more



We're upfront about this because we're looking for someone to grow with us long term, not a quick in-and-out hire. If you're confident in what you can do, this path will reward you quickly.

Keen? 



Here's How to Apply

Send the following to 

Your show reel or portfolio link (or several video examples like a brand video and social media reels/ ads you've edited)

A short paragraph on your storytelling approach as an editor

Your availability (hours/days) and current setup (software, hardware, internet speed, and storage capacity)



Looking forward to hearing from you!



- Walter Neilands
